faqs.q: What is the minimum stake on Cricbet99?
faqs.a: Minimum stakes vary by market but generally start very low, allowing you to learn the platform without high risk.

faqs.q: How do I know if my bet was successful?
faqs.a: Every placed bet is recorded in your 'Active Bets' history. Once the market is settled, your winnings are automatically added to your balance.

faqs.q: Can I cancel a bet once it's placed?
faqs.a: Once a bet is confirmed on the exchange, it cannot be canceled. This is why we recommend double-checking your stake before hitting confirm.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on how much I can bet?
faqs.a: Maximum stakes depend on market liquidity. Large markets like IPL generally accommodate very high positions for professional traders.
